title: Dutch Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew originating from the Netherlands, slow-cooked in a Dutch oven with tender beef and root vegetables.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: chuck or round, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the beef to a large Dutch oven or heavy pot.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and potato to the pot.
Pour in the water and add the allspice, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew in the preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
